desc: Parse \(N,M\) and store each prescribed cell with its row, column, and color.
Sort cells by row descending, processing black cells before white cells in equal rows.
Maintain the maximum column among processed black cells.
Reject any white cell whose column is at most the maintained maximum.
Output `Yes` if no contradiction is found, using the required stdin/stdout Python format.
Reduce the conditions to checking whether any prescribed white cell is southeast of a prescribed black cell.
Verify the solution against all four public samples.
